6.77 rsIneffectiveSortExpressionScope
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsIneffectiveSortExpressionScope is a non-critical error that occurs if a Textbox element, with the
Textbox.UserSort element present, specifies the current scope for the UserSort.SortExpressionScope
element of the Textbox.
